description: Inspect a backyard with a swimming pool and an outdoor receptacle for special location violations: pool luminaire height, pool bonding and weatherproof receptacle covers.
environmentDescription: A residential backyard with an in-ground pool, a metal ladder and rail, a luminaire hung over the water, and a receptacle on the patio wall.

violations.description: Luminaire hangs 9 feet above the water over a backyard pool

citations.text: Keep luminaires, lighting outlets and ceiling fans out of the airspace above a pool and the 5 ft strip around it unless they sit 12 ft or more above the highest water level.
Keep luminaires, lighting outlets and ceiling fans out of the airspace above a pool and the 5 ft strip around it unless they sit 12 ft or more above the highest water level.

violations.hintText: Check how high the light is above the water, and whether it is over the pool or within 5 ft of its edge.
violations.inspectionNote: The luminaire is about 9 ft above the water level. Over a pool it needs to be at least 12 ft above.

violations.description: Metal pool ladder and handrail are not bonded to the pool's bonding grid

citations.text: Bond the pool's conductive parts together with solid copper no smaller than 8 AWG so they form an equipotential grid, including metal ladders and rails.
Bond the pool's conductive parts together with solid copper no smaller than 8 AWG so they form an equipotential grid, including metal ladders and rails.
Metal parts in the pool zones, such as ladders and rails, are connected together by a supplementary bonding conductor.
citations.hintText: Look for a supplementary bonding conductor on the metal ladder and rail.
citations.inspectionNote: The metal ladder and rail have no supplementary bonding conductor, so they could carry a different voltage than other metal in the zones.

violations.hintText: Look for a bonding conductor on the metal ladder and rail.
violations.inspectionNote: The metal ladder and rail have no bonding conductor to the bonding grid, so they could carry a different voltage than the water.

violations.description: Outdoor patio receptacle has a cover that is only weatherproof when closed

citations.text: In wet locations the receptacle's enclosure must stay weatherproof with or without a plug inserted, which means an in-use (bubble) cover.
In wet locations the receptacle's enclosure must stay weatherproof with or without a plug inserted, which means an in-use (bubble) cover.

violations.hintText: Check the cover on the patio receptacle: does it still close over a plugged-in cord?
violations.inspectionNote: The patio receptacle has a flip cover that cannot close over a plug, so rain reaches the plug and the receptacle while it is in use.

violations.description: Utility service drop runs only 15 feet above the water of the backyard pool

citations.text: Pools, spas and hot tubs may not be placed within the code's clearances of overhead service or other overhead conductors not in a raceway; for 0-750 V insulated service-drop type cable the clearance is 22.5 ft, measured from the maximum water level.

limit.quantity: overhead conductor clearance above maximum water level

citations.text: Pools, spas and hot tubs may not be placed within the code's clearances of overhead service or other overhead conductors not in a raceway; for 0-750 V insulated service-drop type cable the clearance is 22.5 ft, measured from the maximum water level.

limit.quantity: overhead conductor clearance above maximum water level

violations.hintText: Look up at the wires that cross the yard. How high are they compared with the water below?
violations.inspectionNote: The service drop from the pole crosses the pool and hangs about 15 ft above the water. Compare that height with the table limit for overhead conductors near a pool.

sceneFact.note: vertical, from maximum water level up to the lowest point of the service drop

compliantFact.quantity: overhead conductor clearance above maximum water level
compliantFact.note: vertical, from maximum water level up to the lowest point of the service drop

violations.description: A general-purpose {term:receptacle} is mounted about 3 feet from the edge of the pool

citations.text: Receptacles that are not for pool pump motors or other circulation-system loads must be at least 6 ft from the inside wall of a permanently installed pool, measured along the shortest path a cord would take.

limit.quantity: receptacle distance from inside pool wall

citations.text: Receptacles that are not for pool pump motors or other circulation-system loads must be at least 6 ft from the inside wall of a permanently installed pool, measured along the shortest path a cord would take.

limit.quantity: receptacle distance from inside pool wall

violations.hintText: Pace out the distance from the water to the outlet on the pool deck.
violations.inspectionNote: A {term:receptacle} on a post sits a few steps from the pool wall, about 3 ft away. Measure the cord path from the water to it and compare with the minimum distance for pool receptacles.

sceneFact.note: shortest path a cord would follow, from inside pool wall

compliantFact.note: shortest path a cord would follow, from inside pool wall

violations.description: The maintenance disconnect for the hot tub equipment is mounted 2 feet from the spa wall

citations.text: Pool, spa and hot tub equipment other than lighting needs a readily accessible maintenance disconnect within sight of the equipment and at least 5 ft horizontally from the water, measured from the water's edge along the shortest path, unless a permanent barrier gives a 5 ft reach path.

limit.quantity: disconnect distance from inside spa wall

citations.text: Pool, spa and hot tub equipment other than lighting needs a readily accessible maintenance disconnect within sight of the equipment and at least 5 ft horizontally from the water, measured from the water's edge along the shortest path, unless a permanent barrier gives a 5 ft reach path.

limit.quantity: disconnect distance from inside spa wall

violations.hintText: Stand where someone would operate the disconnect. How close is the water?
violations.inspectionNote: A fused disconnect for the spa heater and pump is on the fence post, about 2 ft from the spa wall with nothing between it and the water. Check the distance and whether any barrier separates it from the water.

sceneFact.quantity: disconnect distance from inside spa wall
sceneFact.note: horizontal, measured from water's edge along the shortest path to the disconnect

compliantFact.quantity: disconnect distance from inside spa wall
compliantFact.note: horizontal, measured from water's edge along the shortest path to the disconnect

violations.description: Pool pump is plugged into an outdoor {term:receptacle} with no {term:shock-protection-device}

citations.text: Outlets supplying pool pump motors on single-phase 120 V through 240 V branch circuits need Class A ground-fault protection, whether the pump is on a receptacle or wired directly.
Outlets supplying pool pump motors on single-phase 120 V through 240 V branch circuits need Class A ground-fault protection, whether the pump is on a receptacle or wired directly.

violations.hintText: Check what protects the outlet the pool pump uses.
violations.inspectionNote: The pump cord goes to a plain 20 A {term:receptacle} on the equipment pad with no test/reset device on it, and no protective {term:breaker} is labelled. Decide whether the pump outlet has the protection that pool pump circuits need.

violations.description: A high-rated hardwired EV charger has no readily accessible, lockable disconnect

citations.text: Charging equipment rated over 60 A or over 150 V to ground needs a readily accessible disconnect that can be locked open, with a plaque if it is remote from the equipment.
Charging equipment rated over 60 A or over 150 V to ground needs a readily accessible disconnect that can be locked open, with a plaque if it is remote from the equipment.

violations.hintText: Read the charger's nameplate, then look for where it can be switched off.
violations.inspectionNote: The garage charger nameplate reads 80 A, 240 V and it is hardwired. There is no disconnect at the charger and no plaque saying where one is; the only way to switch it off is a {term:breaker} in a {term:panel} in another room with no provision for locking. Compare the rating with the disconnect rule.

violations.description: A pool equipment timer switch is mounted 2 feet from the pool wall without a barrier

citations.text: Switches, timers and similar devices must be at least 5 ft horizontally from the pool's inside wall, unless a solid fence, wall or other permanent barrier separates them or the device is listed for closer use.

limit.quantity: switching device distance from inside pool wall

citations.text: Switches, timers and similar devices must be at least 5 ft horizontally from the pool's inside wall, unless a solid fence, wall or other permanent barrier separates them or the device is listed for closer use.

limit.quantity: switching device distance from inside pool wall

violations.hintText: Look at the controls for the pool equipment and how near they are to the water.
violations.inspectionNote: A standard timer and light switch box is on a post about 2 ft from the pool wall with open deck between it and the water. Check the distance, and whether any barrier or special listing applies.

violations.description: A wall-mounted underwater pool light has its lens only 6 inches below the normal water level

citations.text: The top of a wall-mounted underwater luminaire lens sits at least 18 in. below normal water level, unless the luminaire is listed for a shallower depth.

limit.quantity: depth of luminaire lens top below normal water level

citations.text: The top of a wall-mounted underwater luminaire lens sits at least 18 in. below normal water level, unless the luminaire is listed for a shallower depth.

violations.hintText: Look at how deep the pool wall light sits under the water line.
violations.inspectionNote: The pool wall light has no marking for shallow installation, and the top of its lens is about 6 in. under the normal water level. Measure from the water line down to the top of the lens.

violations.description: The pump for a permanent in-ground pool is connected with a power cord about 8 feet long

citations.text: A fixed pool pump may be connected with a cord and plug so it can be unplugged for servicing, but for a permanent pool that cord can be no longer than 3 ft.
A fixed pool pump may be connected with a cord and plug so it can be unplugged for servicing, but for a permanent pool that cord can be no longer than 3 ft.

violations.hintText: Look at the pump's power cord and judge how long it is before it reaches the plug.
violations.inspectionNote: The pump cord runs about 8 ft across the equipment pad to a {term:receptacle}, coiled on the ground. Measure from the pump to the plug and compare with the limit for a pool that is built to stay.

sceneFact.note: length of the flexible cord from the pump to the attachment plug

violations.description: The junction box for the 120 V pool light sits flat on the pool deck, only about 1 inch above it

citations.text: The junction box that feeds a standard-voltage pool light (one above the low-voltage limit) must sit at least 4 in above the deck, or 8 in above the highest water level if that is higher.
The junction box that feeds a standard-voltage pool light (one above the low-voltage limit) must sit at least 4 in above the deck, or 8 in above the highest water level if that is higher.

violations.hintText: Find where the pool light's cable ends on the deck and measure how high the box stands above the deck surface.
violations.inspectionNote: A standard 120 V pool light feeds from a box that sits almost flush with the deck, about 1 in above it, where water can pool around it. Measure from the deck surface to the bottom of the box, and compare with the minimum for such a box.

sceneFact.note: measured from the deck surface to the bottom of the box; the box feeds a standard-voltage wet-niche light, not a low-voltage potted one

compliantFact.note: measured from the deck surface to the bottom of the box; also at least 8 in above the highest water level
